## Checklist

- [ ] My change is scoped to a single project (or is an intentional repo-wide change).
- [ ] I added or updated tests where it makes sense.
- [ ] The project's checks pass locally (`compileall` / `pytest` or equivalent).
- [ ] I updated the relevant `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` for user-visible changes.
- [ ] I did not commit any secrets (only `.env.example` templates are tracked).
